description: Notices, destructive/fork prompts, toast contracts, and task composer/inspector attribute definitions (ADR 0015, docs/SEPTASK_APPKIT_SURFACES.md).

steps.title: Connect your AI
steps.detail: Let Claude work on tasks with you

steps.title: Add your first task
steps.detail: It lands in your Inbox until you schedule or file it

items.title: Inactive tasks start to fade
items.detail: Undated tasks fade after 14 days without activity and move to Faded. Open or edit a task to bring it back. You can turn this off in Settings.

items.title: Delete this section?
items.message: Its tasks stay in the project.

items.title: Delete this area?
items.message: Its projects stay, detached from the area.

items.title: Delete this project?
items.message: Its tasks move to Recently Deleted.

items.title: Delete Account?
items.message: Your tasks, areas, projects, and conversations are erased from the server and this device.

items.title: Reschedule repeating task?
items.message: Move only this task, or update the repeating schedule to the new date?

prompts.setup: Set up Septena for me using https://septena.app/agents.md
prompts.first: Set up my Septena areas, projects, and tasks by following https://api.septena.app/onboard.md

steps.title: Welcome to Septena
steps.body: A task list you share with your AI.

points.title: On every device
points.detail: Your tasks stay in step on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

points.title: Work with Claude
points.detail: Claude can take a task, ask you a question, and hand back the result.

points.title: Notes keep the context
points.detail: Each project has notes, so you and Claude know what it's for.

steps.title: Sign in to sync
steps.body: Sign in with Apple to keep your tasks on all your devices and to let Claude connect. Septena never sees your Apple password.
steps.footnote: If you skip this, your tasks stay on this device until you sign in.

steps.title: Bring your tasks
steps.body: Start from the list you already have, or start empty.

choices.title: From Things
choices.detail: Copies your areas, projects and tasks. Nothing in Things changes.

choices.title: From Reminders
choices.detail: Pick a Reminders list. Its items wait in your Inbox until you bring them in.

choices.title: Start empty
choices.detail: Add tasks as they come up.

steps.title: Connect Claude
steps.body: Claude reads and changes your tasks through your Septena account. You decide which tasks it works on.
instructions: Copy the setup prompt and paste it into Claude.
When Claude shows a code, enter it below.
Paste the first prompt. Claude sets up your areas and projects with you.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: Today shows what to do now. Anything you skipped stays on the Get started list.
steps.returningBody: This account is already set up. Your tasks are syncing to this device.
